## UI polish: PlanBar I made 11 fixes across Spacing, Typography, Contrast, Hierarchy, Layout, States and Tokens. All text is unchanged, and so is the brand hue. Tokens from tokens.css. ### Fixes 1. **Spacing**: The container gap `gap-[10px]` was off the scale. It's now `gap-[var(--space-12)]` (tie between 8 and 12, so the larger one). (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 2. **Spacing**: The container padding `p-[13px]` was off the scale. It's now `p-[var(--space-12)]`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 3. **Spacing**: The button padding `px-[7px] py-[3px]` was off the scale. It's now `px-[var(--space-8)] py-[var(--space-4)]`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 4. **Typography**: The status text `text-[15px]` was off the scale and below the 16 px minimum for body text. It's now `text-[length:var(--font-size-md)]` with `leading-[var(--line-height-body)]`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-20) 5. **Contrast**: The status text `text-gray-400` (#9ca3af) on white was 2.54:1. It's now `text-[color:var(--color-text-muted)]` at 6.38:1. (R-ui-polish-4, R-ui-polish-20) 6. **Hierarchy**: Both buttons were filled, so there were two primary actions. "Upgrade plan" stays the filled primary button. "Remind me later" is now an outline button using `bg-transparent`, `text-[color:var(--color-action-secondary-text)]` and `border-[var(--border-width-hairline)] border-[color:var(--color-action-secondary-border)]`. (R-ui-polish-5, R-ui-polish-21) 7. **Layout**: The buttons had no minimum size. Both now have `min-h-[var(--size-target-min)] min-w-[var(--size-target-min)]`. (R-ui-polish-7, R-ui-polish-20) 8. **States**: The primary button had no hover style. It now has `hover:bg-blue-700` (#1d4ed8, 6.70:1 with white text). (R-ui-polish-6) 9. **States**: The secondary button had no hover style. It now has `hover:bg-[var(--color-selected-bg)]`. (R-ui-polish-6, R-ui-polish-20) 10. **States**: Neither button had a focus style. Both now have `focus-visible:outline focus-visible:outline-[length:var(--border-width-focus)] focus-visible:outline-[color:var(--color-border-focus)] focus-visible:outline-offset-2`. (R-ui-polish-6, R-ui-polish-20) 11. **Tokens**: I swapped raw values for tokens with the same value: `bg-white` is now `bg-[var(--color-surface-default)]`, `rounded` (4px) is now `rounded-[var(--radius-sm)]`, and the primary button's `text-white` is now `text-[color:var(--color-action-primary-text)]`. (R-ui-polish-20) ### Contrast | Text | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | "Trial ends in 3 days" | #9ca3af on #ffffff, 2.54:1 | `--color-text-muted` (#4a6462) on `--color-surface-default` (#ffffff), 6.38:1 | | "Upgrade plan" | #ffffff on #2563eb, 5.17:1 | `--color-action-primary-text` (#ffffff) on #2563eb, 5.17:1 | | "Upgrade plan" (hover) | none | `--color-action-primary-text` (#ffffff) on #1d4ed8, 6.70:1 | | "Remind me later" | #ffffff on #2563eb, 5.17:1 | `--color-action-secondary-text` (#0f766e) on `--color-surface-default` (#ffffff), 5.47:1 | | "Remind me later" (hover) | none | `--color-action-secondary-text` (#0f766e) on `--color-selected-bg` (#f0fdfc), 5.25:1 | Ratios computed with the contrast script. ### Polished code ```jsx export function PlanBar({ onUpgrade, onSkip }) { return (
Trial ends in 3 days
); } ``` ### Not changed - All visible text, word for word. - Props, handlers and component name: `PlanBar`, `onUpgrade`, `onSkip`. - Brand hue kept: the primary button's `bg-blue-600` (#2563eb). - Token file: not edited. ### Open questions - The primary button uses `bg-blue-600` (#2563eb, 5.17:1 with white text), but the token `--color-action-primary-bg` is #0f766e (5.47:1). I kept the blue because it already passes. If the token should win, switch to `bg-[var(--color-action-primary-bg)] hover:bg-[var(--color-action-primary-bg-hover)]` so the primary button matches the teal secondary button and focus ring. - The primary hover `hover:bg-blue-700` (#1d4ed8) has no matching token. Add one to the token file, or confirm it stays. - I made "Upgrade plan" the primary action because the two buttons were styled the same. Say if "Remind me later" should be primary instead.
